title: Command vault
text: Save any command or script under a short name. Tag it, describe it, run it with -x.

title: History that knows folders
text: An optional shell hook records each command with the folder it ran in. Secrets are skipped.

title: Tidy duplicates
text: Remove duplicate lines from your history file. Multi-line commands stay whole. A backup is written first.

title: Two-way sync
text: Point two PCs at one folder. CWM merges both ways, and deletes stick.

title: Undo for deletes
text: Deleted commands go to a trash buffer of 100. Restore one by name.
